correctness.rationale: For n≥3 ideal grow/shrink copy maps rotate a lone 1 exactly, and every ideal block has untouched 0 and 1 anchors. Finite weighted activation block approximates its copy map by (1-p)^N. Geometric errors sum to 1/8, while anchors are never updated within the block, yielding diameter >3/4 at every single update. For n=2 every action contracts diameter by ≤q<1; nested extrema converge to consensus. Rational checker tests exact indexing and intermediate steps; the proof, not finite enumeration, handles the universal domain.

value.rationale: The result locates sharp minimal vertex and arc counts for adversarial strong-fairness nonconsensus on strongly connected simple directed networks and demonstrates that multiple in-neighbors are not necessary. It classifies every oriented ring of arbitrary size and arbitrary interior fixed edge weights, with an all-time quantitative diameter bound, which is a meaningful natural graph-family boundary motivated by the parent four-arc witness.
